analysis_steps.goal: Joint sine-wave fit of OVRO and ACT light curves

method.value: Maximise a Gaussian likelihood with per-light-curve offset, amplitude, phase and a correlated-noise term xi added in quadrature to the errors, period held fixed; phase shift defined relative to OVRO

evidence.quote: We fitted a sine wave function to the OVRO and ACT data by maximizing the following likelihood function:
there are four free parameters per light curve: the sine-wave offset $\bar{S}_j$, amplitude $A_j$, and phase $\phi_j$, plus a term quantifying the correlated noise in the data, $\xi_j$.
the reference time for the sinusoid phase is set at $t_0 =$ MJD 59 000 (2020 May 31)

assumptions.value: No noise covariance between different light curves; effectively independent fits sharing one period

evidence.quote: does not assign any noise covariance between different light curves; they are essentially independent fits, all using the same period that is measured in the OVRO data.
